title: Technical Facility Audit: Continuous Pilot Hydrometallurgy Facility Stuttgart
publisher: Fraunhofer Institute & State Industrial Environment Registry
text: Facility inspection confirms continuous acid-leach pilot reactor operating at steady-state 1,000 t/a throughput processing NMC622 black mass. System achieves continuous closed-loop operation with chemical recovery loops intact.

title: Selective Organic Leaching of Spent Lithium-Ion Cathodes at Moderate Temperatures
publisher: European Journal of Sustainable Metallurgy, Vol. 18
text: Analytical ICP-MS assays confirm 95.8 ± 0.4% lithium recovery with iron and aluminum contaminant concentrations below 10 ppm. Cathode precursor achieves 99.6% battery-grade purity.

title: EP3892011B1: Ultrasonic-Assisted Organic Acid Leaching for Mixed Battery Waste
text: Granted patent with 14 independent claims covering ultrasonic selective extraction of lithium carbonate without chlorine gas emissions.

title: Circura Materials Corporate Sustainability & Life-Cycle Assessment 2024
text: Internal life-cycle assessment models demonstrate that Circura proprietary hydrometallurgical processing cuts carbon emissions by 68% compared to traditional pyrometallurgical smelting baselines.

title: Industrial Demonstration Facility Operating Permit #ON-7782
publisher: Ontario Ministry of the Environment & Climate Change
text: Authorizes continuous demonstration pilot testing for hydrometallurgical solvent recovery facility up to 500 t/year operational capacity under ambient pressure conditions.

title: Ambient Pressure Solvent Stripping of Cobalt and Lithium from Black Mass
publisher: Canadian Journal of Chemical Engineering, Vol. 102
text: Experimental trial data demonstrates 94.2% lithium extraction efficiency at 45°C without requiring high-pressure autoclaves.

title: Classified Industrial Environmental Authorization Permit #FR-2019-881
publisher: French Regional Directorate for Environment, Planning and Housing (DREAL)
text: Authorizes 15,000 t/year commercial pyrometallurgical smelting furnace for secondary alloy production. Slag output classified under non-hazardous industrial waste.

title: PyroLoop Announces Novel Slag Extraction Capturing Over 85% Lithium
text: PyroLoop claims new proprietary secondary fluxing process recovers 85% of lithium directly from smelting slag. Independent metallurgical audit not yet published.
